correctness.rationale: With m>=2 and every nonnegative integer l, the addition formula U_l(cos theta)=sum_{r=0}^l exp(i(l-2r)theta) is exact. Two orthogonal regular 2m-gons give identical circulant blocks and a constant cross block U_l(0), which is 0 for odd l and a unit sign for even l. The DFT counts each allowed residue exactly, and the constant block has the displayed +/- split. Counting parity residues yields all ranks, and exact min/max positive counts yield every ratio including l=0, l=2m-2, l=2m. An exact frequency increment yields the matrix translation identity. Independent standard-library direct construction and 8,460 exact cases corroborated the proof, but finite checks were not used as an infinite argument.
